sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: Pray for one another: Thanksgiving and Requests
Sing a song of praise together
Review & Accountability
To whom did you tell Jesus’ story?
Have someone teach the “Hand Gospel”
What was the topic of the last lesson? What did you learn?
(The Lord’s Supper)

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
As we grow in Christ, we should aim to obey Him in all areas of our life. Today, we will focus on the area of giving.
Acts 20:35
Acts 4:32-37 (churches help one another)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
It is more of a blessing when we give to those who are in need than when we receive.
The Church came together and used what had been given to help one another.
There was no one needy among them.
The people of the Church shared all the things that they had.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Give everyone an opportunity to give an offering (money, food, etc.).
An offering could be food, money, or something else.
Use what is given to help those in need and to further God’s Kingdom.
Let the group decide for what the offering will be used.
Keep a notebook with a responsible person in the group to keep account of how this money is used. Calculate this weekly for the group.
Challenge each person to help one another as the need arises.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God’s name will be made great among all people and places. Let’s commit to give our lives for the sake of His name going forth.
Malachi 1:11
Pray
Ask God to help us use what we have been given to bless others and to bring glory to God.
